title: Skip legacy API resource probe

acceptanceCriteria: Do not call /api/v1 when LA_LEGACY_SYNC is false.
Retain the probe when LA_LEGACY_SYNC is true.
constraints: Do not change operation-backend bearer-token traffic.
Do not change persisted data or schema.

output.summary: Guards the legacy resource-index probe behind LA_LEGACY_SYNC so operation-backend-only boot does not request frontend-origin /api/v1.

filesChanged.purpose: Skip the obsolete legacy API resource-index probe when legacy sync is disabled.

behaviorChanges.before: Always made GET /api/v1 and received a legacy-session 401.
behaviorChanges.after: Makes no /api/v1 request while LA_LEGACY_SYNC is false.

changed: Legacy REST resource-index discovery is conditional on LA_LEGACY_SYNC.

details: No database, schema, mapper, or write-path change.

decisions: Use the existing LA_LEGACY_SYNC flag to preserve legacy compatibility.
risks: Other unmigrated legacy features remain unavailable in operation-backend-only sessions by design.
dependencies: Deploy this branch and reload the browser.
followUps: Migrate remaining legacy frontend data paths to operation-backend resources.
rollback: Revert this commit to restore the unconditional legacy /api/v1 resource-index probe.
